items.label: T2
items.content: Nominate a Life-changing Teacher

items.label: T3
items.content:
The Carlston Family Foundation tries to find teachers who have had a profound, life-changing academic influence on their students and to provide for such teachers reward, recognition and a platform for their ideas to help shape the education environment of the California public school system.
Nominating Form

items.label: T4
items.content: If you have had a life-changing experience with a teacher, we'd like to hear about it.  We are looking for people whose lives have been turned around academically and who attribute that turnaround to an extraordinary individual.  If you are such a person, we'd like to hear your story.

items.label: Q6
items.prompt: Please tell us in your own words what made your experience with this teacher so special and life-changing. Tell us about who you were before you met this teacher, who you became, and how this teacher made such a difference to you. _______________________________________________________________________________

items.label: Q7
items.prompt: Specific examples of a teacher's teaching techniques and approaches to students are important to understanding what makes one particularly effective. Share with us some specific examples of things this teacher did that made him or her such an effective teacher. _______________________________________________________________________________

items.label: T6
items.content:
The Details
Here are the little details about both you and your former teacher that we need in order to consider this nomination.  Thank you for being as complete as possible.

items.label: Q13
items.question: As far as you know, is your nominee still teaching?
items.name: StillTeaching?

items.label: Q14
items.question: As far as you know, is your nominee still at your old school?
items.name: StillThere?

items.label: T7
items.content: And now a little more about you...

items.label: Q15
items.prompt: Tell us about your academic life since high school, where you attended, dates, your major, accomplishments, degrees, etc. _______________________________________________________________________________

items.label: Q16
items.prompt: If you are no longer in school or spent some time doing other things, please tell us about them too. _______________________________________________________________________________

items.label: Q17
items.prompt: Finally, can you tell us about any special circumstances in your own life that made your academic success surprising or unusual? _______________________________________________________________________________
